name: Gold (fear gauge)
summary: Gold near $4,053, down 8.8% over three months, past the 8% fall Watch line
state: Gold futures were near $4,053 early on 6 Nov, 8.8% lower over three months, just past the 8% fall that marks Watch (Yahoo Finance). The price is 2.1% higher on the week, far below the 7% single-week Alert line, and about 24% under its 52-week high.
for_you: A large fall in gold signals a shift in how markets price safety; it says little on its own about near-term risk.
why: Gold is the oldest crisis hedge; disorderly surges signal fear about currencies, inflation or geopolitics.
drivers: Real interest rates, central-bank buying, geopolitical fear, dollar moves.

rubric.alert: 3-month gain > 20%, or a single-week move > 7% either way.
